limitations: Only positive-weight REVIVE244 is included. Source value10 is the passive revival amount; the ordinary Card HP field remains0 so this is not mislabeled as a standalone heal.
The source scans room.players in fixed order for HP0 and deadfalse. With at least2 not.dead seats and a244 card, it directly discards the first244, adds10HP and continues without finalizing death.
Passive consumption gives no replacement gift and consumes no RNG, decision, MP or retained ability. Disease, harms and worseChance are not cleared.
Already dead seats cannot revive. The alive check counts not.dead, not HPpositive; simultaneous HP0 therefore has fixed-seat-order asymmetry.

The death boundary occurs before the next queued item and before the owner disease tick. A tick death causes another scan without repeating the same tick. Provisional HP0 during an unresolved reflection chain does not trigger yet.
Multiple244 cards are consumed one at a time at separate death boundaries. Manual discard is allowed, but standalone use is invalid because the SUNDRY attack kind is empty.

DYING_ATTACK117 remains excluded: after revival the death scan continues, and without revival it marks the seat dead before requiring2 remaining alive seats. Its death effect stays unreachable in a2-seat duel even when244 is supported.
